propositions: PydanticAIRunner.run() method spans 408 lines (59% of runner.py) and must be decomposed along three seams: interpret_failure (except spine), build_model_settings/build_usage_limits (settings block), and provider session guard

A verified resource leak exists where ProviderSession is constructed at line 301 but the try-finally guard begins at line 474, exposing lines 301-473 to leaks when exceptions raised by _check_tool_capability occur
The method must be extracted into three separate plain functions landing in sequence, each leaving runner.py under 700 LOC per patchset to pass CI verification gates
ProviderSession.__enter__ and __exit__ exist but are unused; the extraction must wrap construction in a context manager to close the session on all paths including pre-call exceptions
The decomposition must preserve all measured facts, file citations, bug/story IDs, and failure modes in comments across runner.py and structured_run.py without deletion

Six monkeypatch.setattr targets in tests must be repointed in the same commit that relocates their definitions, with hazards specifically on cache_settings_for, _pai_model, and _local_proxy_bypass_base_url
